Inurnment Explained 3Likes150ViewsApr 12026 This video is created by The Funeral Channel Network is brought to you by The Funeral Program Site — ever heard the term inurnment and wondered what it means? Inurnment is the placement of cremated ashes into a final resting place, whether that’s a columbarium niche, burial in the ground, or a family plot. It offers a meaningful way to honor a loved one and create a place for remembrance. Cremation doesn’t mean there’s no service—it simply means a different kind of goodbye.
